name: sim_ac2_mercedes_standings_priority
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: How did Mercedes do recently and where do we stand in the championship?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_driver_standings with args {'season': 2026.0, 'category': 'all'}
Agent: Mercedes-AMG Petronas is leading the 2026 Constructors Championship in first place with 538 points. In the Drivers Championship, Kimi Antonelli in car 12 is in first place with 302 points and George Russell in car 63 is in second place with 236 points. It has been a fantastic season for the Silver Arrows so far with eleven wins and twenty podiums in total.
User: That is great news, thanks for the update!
Agent: You are very welcome. It is a brilliant time to be a Silver Arrows fan with both Kimi Antonelli and George Russell performing so well at the top of the standings. Let me know if you would like to know when the next race is or if there is anything else I can help you with.
